en: A vintage sepia postcard showing a panoramic view of Athens with the Acropolis and the Parthenon on the hill in the background. In the foreground is a broad boulevard with formal gardens and buildings on either side, labeled as Boulevard Olga. Ancient ruins, likely the Temple of Olympian Zeus, appear to the left. The postcard includes captions in Greek and French and a printed web address/logo at the bottom.
